title: Concurrent budget reservation: one remaining allowance, idempotent, unknown stays unknown
note: Synthetic. Lists the function exercised, the input and the expected outcome; authored, not run. No number here is a measurement of real rendering, latency, memory or cost.

calls.case: limit 100k tokens, usage known, spent 20k; three parallel jobs of 30k each (headroom 25%) from separate processes
the same op_id requested again after a transient failure
actual 22k; the same call twice; failed with no usage
usage unreported with a limit set; three jobs
no limit set and usage unreported

expect: the first two fit (37.5k each against 80k remaining is 75k), the third is refused budget_unavailable with the remaining amount: reservations never overlap because they run under one lock
the retry returns the same reservation (idempotent true), never a second one
reconcile releases the unused part once; the second call is idempotent; a failure with no usage releases it and a retry reopens the same record
unreported usage allows at most 2 concurrent reservations (conservative) and says so
no limit: reservations are recorded as unknown with null amounts, concurrency conservative, no dollar precision invented
an unreported actual keeps the amount counted as an estimate against the allowance
